mechanics.claim: Each shot fired during the swing is a separate cast instance that applies on-hit effects.
mechanics.quote: Each shot is a separate {{tip|cast instance}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability applies on-hit effects with each shot.
Shots can critically strike and apply life steal.
mechanics.quote: The shots can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}}}and {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Akshan immediately fires one shot at the start of the swing and a final shot while dismounting.
mechanics.quote: '''Akshan''' immediately fires one shot at the beginning of his swing and a final shot while dismounting from the swing.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks only a single shot from this ability.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single shot.

mechanics.claim: The ability does not apply on-attack effects but does trigger Navori Flickerblade's Transcendence.
mechanics.quote: Despite this ability not applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects, it does apply {{iis|Navori Flickerblade}} {{nie|Transcendence}}.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the ability's effect (all casts) completes.
Damage is calculated based on Akshan's current stats and updates dynamically as the swing progresses.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

mechanics.claim: The attack speed scaling on shot damage includes Akshan's innate bonus attack speed growth.
mechanics.quote: The attack speed scaling on the damage of the attacks includes the bonus attack speed gained from '''Akshan's''' innate attack speed growth.
